detailed_descriptions.en: This is a flexible strategy card game infused with Rogue-lite elements, where every adventure brims with unpredictability. Confronting randomized dungeons, unexpected events, and a multiverse setting, each choice you make will forge a completely unique gaming experience. Build Your Deck , Explore Endless Dungeons! The '1+4' minimalist deck-building system : 1 core card + 4 support cards Five elements : Water, Fire, Wood, Light, Dark – craft unpredictable builds Diverse rune customization : unique abilities to elevate your combat experience Over 300 cards to strategize with,every battle presents a new deck-building challenge! Flexibly adapt your battle deck then immerse in strategic thrills. In-run deck crafting & evolution: Even unwanted cards forge your path to power. Diverse dungeon modules: Every expedition ventures into the unknown. Fresh treasures & formidable foes await your discovery. Randomized encounters await in your adventure,shape your destiny with every decision. Recover, upgrade, or warp unpredictably,prove your mastery of strategy & serendipity. Salvage loots from failed runs,the meta progressions improve your power. Beyond a single dungeon.An intricate multiverse where infinite possibilities converge.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
This is a flexible strategy card game infused with Rogue-lite elements, where every adventure brims with unpredictability. Confronting randomized dungeons, unexpected events, and a multiverse setting, each choice you make will forge a completely unique gaming experience.

Build Your Deck , Explore Endless Dungeons!

  • The '1+4' minimalist deck-building system : 1 core card + 4 support cards

  • Five elements : Water, Fire, Wood, Light, Dark – craft unpredictable builds

  • Diverse rune customization : unique abilities to elevate your combat experience

  • Over 300 cards to strategize with,every battle presents a new deck-building challenge!

  • Flexibly adapt your battle deck then immerse in strategic thrills.

  • In-run deck crafting & evolution: Even unwanted cards forge your path to power.

  • Diverse dungeon modules: Every expedition ventures into the unknown.

  • Fresh treasures & formidable foes await your discovery. 

  • Randomized encounters await in your adventure,shape your destiny with every decision.

  • Recover, upgrade, or warp unpredictably,prove your mastery of strategy & serendipity.

  • Salvage loots from failed runs,the meta progressions improve your power.

  • Beyond a single dungeon.An intricate multiverse where infinite possibilities converge.
